title: Page 2
content_zh:
夏羽柔愣了愣，指着自己，见他点头，只能乖乖出去，但一出去，她立刻闪身靠壁偷听，再从窗口偷偷瞄。
房内，一大一小开始论起文章，你来我往，她就见弟弟的目光愈来愈亮，点头如捣蒜，到最后，躬身深深一礼，「请汤爷教导。」
汤绍玄伸手虚扶，「很好。」他突然看向门口，「听够了？可以进来了。」
夏羽柔心虚的开门进去。
汤绍玄只瞥她一眼，就看着夏羽晨问：「寒窗读书为求功名，你认为你能站到什么位置？」
夏羽柔看着认真思考的弟弟，突然想到人渣前夫，乡试是地方考试，当年郑凯中了亚元，隔年的会试却名落孙山，可见科举一途多么艰难……
夏羽晨接着说的话，差点令她软脚。
「弟子要连中三元、三元及第，要成为我朝上史上第一人也是最年轻的状元郎。」夏羽晨说的郑重。
夏羽柔有些手足无措，不知要开心还是要泼弟弟冷水，她没想到这孩子志向如此远大，还说得脸不红，气不喘，弟啊，口气会不会太大？
没想到汤绍玄竟认真的点头，「很好。」
夏羽柔愕然地瞪大了眼，还没开口，就见大面瘫跟小面瘫正经八百的讨论着日后的上课计划，画面莫名有喜感，她也只好把话咽回肚子里。
待他们谈完，夏羽柔憋着一肚子笑，也郑重的行个礼，「日后麻烦汤爷了。」
「阿晨请汤夫子指教。」夏羽晨认认真真的又给汤绍玄作个揖。
「日后叫我汤大哥就行。」汤绍玄大方受礼，但要他改口。
夏羽柔眼睛一亮，「那阿柔也……」
「汤爷。」汤某人俊脸上波澜不兴。
夏羽柔本想跟着套关系，被直接拒绝，她莫名有种被嫌弃的感觉，愤愤的生起闷气，「是，汤爷。」
夫子跟学生达成共识，汤绍玄每天下午过来一趟，上课时间约一个时辰，但夏羽柔听了有意见——
「还是傍晚上课吧，汤爷上完课顺便用完晚膳再回去？」这是她的良心建议，他来上课她送一顿晚饭，一方面是趁机让彼此的交情再上一层楼，人情愈多，她脑袋愈牢，另一方面是，聊到现在都没谈到束修，用晚餐抵束修，她比较划得来。
汤绍玄想到自己一人用晚膳的情景，点头应了。

「那就从明天开始上课，现在离晚膳时分不远，汤爷留下用餐再走，阿晨，带着你的『汤大哥』去咱们家里四处逛逛。」夏羽柔特别加重那三个字，小小的发泄她的不满。
汤绍玄怎会不知她的小心思，嘴角微勾，跟着夏羽晨走了。
夏羽晨的心情也很好，再来的日子，不必去书院浪费时间，跟着汤绍玄，他可以学得更多，他一直都清楚，唯有他入朝为官，才能改变家里境况，还有姊姊，一旦他成为高官，不管姊姊有没有嫁过人，有没有再嫁人，外人都不敢看轻或欺侮她——像是前姊夫家。
因前程有望，小面瘫心绪飞扬，眉眼带笑的带着汤绍玄在自家逛起来。
其实，上次夏羽柔醉酒，汤绍玄已进过后院，不过，那日情形混乱，他并未仔细打量。
夏羽晨带他先往后院走，右边空地以栅栏圈了一个鸡窝，还用渔网围住，避免鸡飞乱跑，居中有一口水井，一旁有三畦绿油油的菜地，另一边有几棵果树，葡萄架下已有两串小葡萄，架子下设了石桌、石凳，左边还有一个鱼池。
汤绍玄又想到她日日到山林采些野菜，不禁觉得她精明，伙食费可省不少。
大厨房内，她准备的干货不说，盐、辣椒、米粮、面粉、酱油、米、醋等井然有序的排列或堆在架上，竟还设了小冰窖，里面有不少肉类，猪、鸡、鸭、鱼皆有。
夏羽晨跟他说：「姊姊都是一次购足大量食材，等缺了，自己去补或叫店家送来。」
两人绕了好大一圈回到大厨房的后方，那里有一座简单烤炉，夏羽柔正在那里忙活。
在两人去逛后，她就开始揉面皮，这时站在烤炉前，先揭开烤炉前的挡板，再将烤饼放进去，见两人绕回来，她又赶两人先到食堂稍坐。
烤炉里香味飘出，她将烤饼拿出来，又回到厨房里，简单做了几道菜跟汤品，再加上香喷喷的烤饼，就是今天的晚餐。
汤绍玄胃口极好，烤饼微咸，看似松软实则紮实，他连吃五块再加爽口好吃的小菜，最后有点吃撑了，夏羽柔姊弟目送他离去。
「姊，汤大哥知识渊博，比书院任何一个夫子的学识都要厉害。」
小面瘫还是小面瘫，但从他发亮的瞳眸，夏羽柔还是感觉到他打从心底的喜悦，心头一片温软。
「那你更要好好用功了。」她笑说。
姊弟俩说笑着回了屋里，收拾碗盘，可没多久，夏家食堂大门被人敲响，夏羽柔开了门，一看到对方，大吃一惊。
「你是谁啊？是不是找错地方了，你也被打得太惨了，我这儿可不是医馆。」
夏羽晨也一脸困惑，但再仔细看，就认出人了，「你是靳——」
「我是靳工头。」

夏羽柔错愕，竟是雇用弟弟的刻薄工头？
也难怪夏羽晨认不太出来，靳工头鼻青脸肿，也不知被谁揍成猪头，在他身后还跟着两名工人，一人手里拿着簿子，一人手里拿着钱袋子。
「你的工钱。」靳工头因身上的伤痛得龇牙咧嘴，但还是努力挤出善意的笑，殊不知在他人眼里，有些狰狞。
「怎么回事？靳工头你怎么找到这里？」夏羽晨皱眉，看着手上的银子还有些不知所以。
靳工头疼得眉头都要打结，连理都没理，回头问了另一名翻看簿子的工人，「还有人吗？」
该名工人点头，「有，昌明街的许二牛，然后是采青巷的严家兄弟，还有……」
「行了，先去昌明街。」靳工头烦躁的挥手。
三人呼啦啦的又上马车走人。
夏家姊弟一脸困惑，但消息灵通的邻居立刻走过来，兴致勃勃的问：「阿晨，你也去给靳工头搬过货？」
「是啊，林婶子。」
「可是没拿到钱，还被打了一顿？」林婶子一副「我就知道」的样子，接着就把她今天午后在港口看到的奇事给说了。
原来，靳工头也不知得罪那一号大人物，光天化日之下被掳走不说，还让人狠狠打了一顿丢回码头，更令人错愕的是，靳工头顾不得一身伤，开始拿着钱跟册子寻人了，说要将过去积欠苛扣雇工的工钱一一归还。
夏羽柔姊弟对看一眼，又惊又喜。
「我跟你们说，我还听到码头的人说，掳走他的人说了句狠话，说他若没有把欠下的薪资还给雇工，会让他家里的人一天一个看不到明天的太阳。」
难怪了，那么恶劣的突然转性给钱了？只是，谁有这么大的能耐？
夏羽柔突然想到汤绍玄，但旋即又否决了，不可能吧，他生性冷漠，怎么会去管这种闲事？但不管如何？弟弟总算没有白做工。
夏羽晨坚持把一两银给她，这是他人生赚的第一笔钱。
夏羽柔推辞不过，便说：「行，姊替你存下来，日后给你讨妻子。」
小面瘫又恼又羞，「不用，这是我给姊姊存的第一笔嫁妆！」
「姊才不嫁。」

「我一定让姊嫁。」
「嫁谁？」
「汤大哥。」
夏羽柔真是无言以对。
第八章 不敢承认对她动心(2)
雨季结束，天气转睛变热，采石场的工人又打着赤膊干活儿，在烈日下，个个皮肤晒得黝黑发亮，举着铁敲一记记敲打坚硬山石，匡匡作响，汗流浃背，风又热呼呼的吹，让人更添几股火气。
content_en:
Xia Yurou was stunned and pointed at herself. Seeing him nodding, she could only go out obediently. But as soon as she went out, she immediately leaned against the wall to eavesdrop, and then peeked through the window.
In the room, the older one and the younger one began to discuss the article, and as they came and went, she saw her younger brother's eyes getting brighter and brighter, and he nodded like garlic. In the end, he bowed deeply and said, "Please teach Mr. Tang."
Tang Shaoxuan stretched out his hand to help, "Very good." He suddenly looked at the door, "Have you heard enough? You can come in."
Xia Yurou opened the door and went in with a guilty conscience.
Tang Shaoxuan only glanced at her, then looked at Xia Yuchen and asked, "Han Chuang is studying for fame. Where do you think you can stand?"
Xia Yurou looked at her brother who was thinking seriously, and suddenly thought of her scumbag ex-husband. The provincial examination was a local examination. Zheng Kai won the Asian Yuan in the local examination, but failed in the national examination the following year. This shows how difficult the imperial examination was...
What Xia Yuchen said next almost made her weak.
"Disciple must win three yuan and three yuan in a row, and become the first and youngest number one scholar in our history." Xia Yuchen said solemnly.
Xia Yurou was a little at a loss. She didn't know whether to be happy or to throw cold water on her brother. She didn't expect that this child had such lofty ambitions, and he said it without blushing or breathing. Brother, is your tone too loud?
Unexpectedly, Tang Shaoxuan nodded seriously, "Very good."
Xia Yurou's eyes widened in astonishment. Before she could speak, she saw Big Face and Little Face discussing their future class plans seriously. The scene was inexplicably joyful, and she had to swallow the words back in her stomach.
After they finished talking, Xia Yurou suppressed her laughter and saluted solemnly, "I'll trouble Mr. Tang in the future."
"Ah Chen asked Master Tang for advice." Xia Yuchen bowed to Tang Shaoxuan seriously.
"Just call me Brother Tang from now on." Tang Shaoxuan accepted the courtesy generously, but asked him to change his words.
Xia Yurou's eyes lit up, "Then Ah Rou..."
"Master Tang." Mr. Tang's handsome face was expressionless.
Xia Yurou originally wanted to start a relationship, but was rejected outright. She felt inexplicably disgusted and sulked angrily, "Yes, Mr. Tang."
The master and the students reached a consensus that Tang Shaoxuan would come here every afternoon and the class would last about an hour, but Xia Yurou had some objections after hearing this——
"Let's go to class in the evening. Mr. Tang will finish class and have dinner before going back?" This was her conscientious suggestion. When he came to class, she gave him a dinner. On the one hand, she took the opportunity to take the friendship between them to a higher level. The more favors she had, the stronger her head would be. On the other hand, they hadn't talked about Shu Xiu until now. It was more cost-effective for her to use dinner to compensate for Shu Xiu.
Tang Shaoxuan thought of having dinner alone and nodded in agreement.
"Then classes will start tomorrow. It's not far from dinner time now. Mr. Tang will stay and eat before leaving. Ah Chen, take your 'Brother Tang' to our house for a walk." Xia Yurou emphasized those three words in particular to vent her dissatisfaction.
How could Tang Shaoxuan not know her little thoughts? He slightly hooked up his lips and followed Xia Yuchen away.
Xia Yuchen was also in a good mood. He didn't have to waste time in the academy in the coming days. He could learn more by following Tang Shaoxuan. He always knew that only by becoming an official in the court could he change the situation of his family. And his sister. Once he became a high-ranking official, no matter whether his sister had been married or remarried, outsiders would not dare to look down on or bully her - like the family of her ex-brother-in-law.
Because of the promising future, Xiao Mian Peng was in high spirits and took Tang Shaoxuan around his house with a smile on his face.
In fact, the last time Xia Yurou was drunk, Tang Shaoxuan had already entered the backyard. However, the situation was chaotic that day and he did not look carefully.
Xia Yuchen took him to the backyard first. There was a chicken coop surrounded by a fence on the right side and a fishing net to prevent the chickens from flying around. There was a well in the middle, with three green vegetable fields on one side and several fruit trees on the other side. There were two bunches of small grapes under the grape trellis. There were stone tables and benches under the trellis, and there was a fish pond on the left.
Tang Shaoxuan thought of her againI go to the mountains and forests every day to pick some wild vegetables. I can't help but feel that she is smart and can save a lot on food expenses.
In the large kitchen, not to mention the dry goods she prepared, salt, chili, rice, flour, soy sauce, rice, vinegar, etc. were arranged or piled on the shelves in an orderly manner. There was also a small ice cellar with a lot of meat in it, including pigs, chickens, ducks, and fish.
Xia Yuchen told him: "My sister always buys a large amount of ingredients at one time. When there is any shortage, she will make up for it herself or ask the store to deliver it."
The two of them walked around a long way back to the back of the large kitchen, where there was a simple oven where Xia Yurou was busy working.
After the two of them went shopping, she started kneading the dough. At this time, she stood in front of the oven, opened the baffle in front of the oven, and then put the scones in. When she saw the two of them coming around, she rushed them to the canteen to sit down for a while.
As the aroma wafted from the oven, she took out the scones and returned to the kitchen. She made a few simple dishes and soups, plus the fragrant scones, and that was today's dinner.
Tang Shao
"Sister, Brother Tang is very knowledgeable. He is more knowledgeable than any other master in the academy."
His face was still paralyzed, but from his bright pupils, Xia Yurou could still feel the joy from the bottom of his heart, and her heart felt tender.
"Then you have to work harder." She said with a smile.
The two sisters laughed and went back to the house to clear away the dishes. But not long after, there was a knock on the door of the Xia family canteen. Xia Yurou opened the door and was shocked when she saw each other.
"Who are you? Are you looking in the wrong place? You were beaten too badly. This is not a medical center."
Xia Yuchen also looked confused, but when he looked carefully, he recognized the person, "You are Jin——"
"I'm Foreman Jin."
Xia Yurou was shocked, she was actually the mean foreman who hired her younger brother?
It's no wonder that Xia Yuchen couldn't recognize him. Foreman Jin had a bruised nose and face, and he didn't know who had beaten him into a pig's head. There were two workers behind him, one with a book in his hand and the other with a money bag.
"Your wages." Foreman Jin grimaced due to the pain on his body, but he still tried his best to smile kindly, but he didn't know that in the eyes of others, it was a bit ferocious.
"What's going on? Foreman Jin, how did you find this place?" Xia Yuchen frowned, looking at the money in his hand still a little confused.
Jin Gong had a headache so hard that his brows were knotted, and he didn't even bother to pay attention. He turned around and asked another worker who was looking at the book, "Is there anyone else?"
The worker nodded, "Yes, Xu Erniu from Changming Street, then the Yan brothers from Caiqing Lane, and..."
"Okay, let's go to Changming Street first." Foreman Jin waved his hand impatiently.
The three of them got into the carriage again and left, cheering.
The Xia siblings looked confused, but a well-informed neighbor immediately came over and asked enthusiastically: "Ah Chen, have you also moved goods for Foreman Jin?"
"Yes, Aunt Lin."
"But you didn't get the money and you were beaten?" Aunt Lin said "I knew it" and then told her about the strange things she saw at the port this afternoon.
It turned out that Foreman Jin didn't know which big shot he had offended. Not only was he kidnapped in broad daylight, he was beaten severely and thrown back to the dock. What was even more shocking was that Foreman Jin didn't care about his injuries and started looking for people with money and booklets, saying that he would return all the wages that had been owed to the employees in the past.
Xia Yurou and her brother looked at each other, surprised and happy.
"Let me tell you, I also heard people at the dock say that the person who kidnapped him said harsh words, saying that if he didn't pay back the wages he owed to his employees, everyone in his family would not be able to see the sun tomorrow."
No wonder, such a bad person suddenly changed his gender and gave money? But, who has such great ability?
Xia Yurou suddenly thought of Tang Shaoxuan, but immediately rejected it. It was impossible. He was indifferent by nature, how could he meddle in such nosy matters? but noNo matter what? My brother finally did not work in vain.
Xia Yuchen insisted on giving her one tael of silver, which was the first money he made in his life.
Xia Yurou couldn't refuse, so she said, "Okay, sister will save it for you and find a wife for you in the future."
The little face was annoyed and ashamed, "No, this is the first dowry I saved for my sister!"
"Sister, I won't marry."
"I will definitely let my sister get married."
"Who to marry?"
"Brother Tang."
Xia Yurou was really speechless.
Chapter 8 I dare not admit that I am attracted to her (2)
The rainy season is over and the weather is getting hotter. Workers in the quarry are working shirtless again. Under the scorching sun, their skin is tanned and shiny. They are hammering hard rocks with irons, making a sound and sweating. The wind is blowing hot, which makes people even more angry.
